data.title: OpenAI to end model access to Cursor after acquisition by Elon Musk's SpaceX
data.description: OpenAI plans to end model access through Cursor on Nov. 12, citing concerns after SpaceX’s $60 billion acquisition of the coding startup.
data.author: Lora Kolodny
